name: player_reset_alt_gun_door_animation_state
description: Player::ResetAltGunDoorAnimationState clears the alt-gun door animation timer and restores optional left/right door nodes to unit scale.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred to the Player alt-gun/runtime-state source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x43c800 validates clearing playerState+0xf2c, null-guarded doorLeftNode and doorRightNode loads at offsets 0xee4 and 0xee8, and zClass_Object3D::gwObject3DSetScale(node, 1, 1, 1) for each present node.
The native smoke verifies the timer clear and unit-scale restore for both door nodes.
